sehemu: Part III: House of Representatives of Zanzibar
jina: House of Representatives of Zanzibar and legislative power over Zanzibar
maudhui: (1) There shall be a House of Representatives of Zanzibar. The House of Representatives shall consist of two parts; one part shall consist of members elected and appointed in the manner prescribed by the Constitution of Zanzibar, 1984, who shall be known as Representatives, and the other part shall be the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar in the exercise of his powers in accordance with this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar, 1984. (2) Where, under this Constitution, the Constitution of Zanzibar, 1984, or any law in force in Zanzibar, any matter is required to be decided or performed by both parts of the House of Representatives, that matter shall not be deemed duly decided or performed unless it has been decided or performed by the Representatives and also by the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar, in accordance with their respective powers in relation to that matter. (3) All legislative power in Zanzibar over all matters which are not Union Matters shall be vested in the House of Representatives of Zanzibar.
